name: Conference Organizer Operations
audience: independent conference organizers and small trade-show teams
topic: speaker assets and sponsor obligations for conference organizers

products.name: Speaker Asset Chaser
products.product: A focused conference speaker asset tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent conference organizers and small trade-show teams
products.problem: Bios, headshots, titles, abstracts, slides, releases, travel details, and AV needs arrive through different speaker email threads and versions.
products.valueProposition: Turns conference speaker asset tracking into a visible operating queue so every confirmed speaker has the approved assets and permissions required for agenda publication, production, and session delivery.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets conference speaker management, speaker asset checklist, speaker portal workflow, and conference presentation tracker searches.

products.name: Sponsor Deliverable Register
products.product: A focused conference sponsor deliverable tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent conference organizers and small trade-show teams
products.problem: Logo placements, booth entitlements, tickets, sessions, lead capture, signage, mentions, and post-event reporting are sold in contracts but fulfilled across separate teams.
products.valueProposition: Turns conference sponsor deliverable tracking into a visible operating queue so every contracted sponsor obligation has an approved input, delivery owner, placement evidence, and accepted outcome.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets event sponsor deliverables, sponsorship fulfillment tracker, conference sponsor management, and sponsor asset checklist searches.
